freeze_rationale: the confirmation stage boundary, the official sample counts, the epoch budget, the paired seed count and the single sealed official-test read are fixed before any result exists, so the confirmation phase cannot be reshaped after seeing development numbers

official_test_policy.executed_only_after: the A2/B1 architecture and every protocol are completely locked
official_test_policy.contents_of_the_single_pass: clean plus every pre-registered robustness condition
official_test_policy.statement: the official test set is never read before the lock and is executed exactly once afterwards; its outcome can never be used to pick an epoch, a condition, a seed or a method

dev_vs_confirmation_boundary.claim_rule: no development-stage number may be presented as a paper or SOTA comparison, and no 318-sample val-dev number may be presented as an official-test result

official_split.source: MUSeg official split as used by the published MUSeg model comparison

training.checkpoint_rule: fixed pre-registered checkpoint rule or a fixed epoch decided at lock time
training.hyperparameters: identical to the A2/B1 protocol locked at lock time

seeds.aggregation: report every individual seed and the 3-seed mean; no seed may be dropped after seeing its result

methods.pairing_rule: identical split, identical seed set, identical epoch count, identical evaluator and identical condition set for every compared member

conditions.must_cover: clean plus every robustness condition pre-registered in the frozen A2/B1 protocol

statistics.reporting_rule: report the 3-seed mean with its across-seed spread and the paired location-group bootstrap interval for every compared condition
